limitations: 24 same-author synthetic 2-page PDFs, three simple layouts. 8 validation, 16 test; each balanced digital/scanned. Labels repeat across documents and vocabulary overlaps. One mildly degraded scan and four semantic/unit/missing-field problem documents. This is not an independent manufacturer-document or general OCR benchmark.

Same-author synthetic English field labels, eight closed classes. Exact label strings are disjoint, but vocabulary and schema concepts overlap; no independent annotation or unseen-vendor/OCR generalization claim. Input is label text only, never values or units.
Closed-class field mapping weights only; OCR/layout weights are unchanged.
State correctness requires the expected error type, not just any blocked or missing value.
Source-bound metric checks values/states and expected pages, not bbox accuracy.
Readiness is not approval: no record is automatically approved or published to the query table.
Mapping timing includes repeated-label caching. Shared OCR was measured once; no speedup claim.
